body.x: BARCELONA, Spain (AVING Special Report on 'Mobile World Congress 2011') -- <Visual News> Motorola Mobility(www.motorola.com) participated to MWC 2011 held in Barcelona, Spain from February 14(local time).

Motorola Mobility packed with tablet 'XOOM' and smartphone 'ARTRIX' which has been unveiled at CES 2011 in Las Vegas, USA. Various accessories and Bluetooth devices related to XOOM and ARTRIX was introduced.

Especially, visitors showed huge interest about 'XOOM' with Google's Android 3.0(Honeycomb) and 'ARTRIX' which is changed into laptop and desktop through Dock. Here are live picture from Motorola booth at MWC 2011.
<AVING Special Report Team for Mobile World Congress 2011: Idea K. Kim, B.J Park, Kevin Choi, Astin Jung, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Hyunkyung Shin, Sehoon Park>
